headline: SoftBank cancels AI data-center gas turbine orders, posts billion-dollar loss
summary: SoftBank pulled out of natural gas turbine orders meant to power AI data centers after overestimating how much capacity it needed, taking a loss of several billion dollars. The move comes days after SoftBank denied Elon Musk's claim that it was defaulting on the orders.
